Override the Starting Hyperparameters

Source: R/objective.R
statmod_hyper_merge.Rd

Merges a caller's hyperparameters into the ones statmod_hyper_start computed, by parameter and by term.

Usage

statmod_hyper_merge(spec, start, user)

Arguments

spec

A StatmodSpec.

start

The hyperparameters as computed.

user

A named list of named lists, or NULL.

Value

The merged structure.

Details

Until a hyperparameter is estimated by an outer criterion it is held at the probe value, which is a placeholder and not a choice: a lasso at \(\lambda = 1\) against an unaveraged log-likelihood of a few hundred observations selects nothing. This is what lets a caller set it.

A vector is matched by name against the penalty's own hyperparameters, so c(lambda = 5) sets that one and leaves the rest where they were; an unnamed vector of the full length replaces them all.

A term is named either by the key the specification holds it under, which is its call deparsed, or by its label – "lasso" rather than "lasso(~noise1 + noise2)". Two terms sharing a label are ambiguous and the keys are asked for instead.
